title: The Wild Veil Again
author: Sebastian Fairweather
blurb: Dominic Reyes, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
